headline: President Bush created a commission to advise on how to carry out the nation's space exploration policy.
what_it_does: This order set up a presidential commission focused on putting U.S. space exploration policy into practice. Based on the title, the commission's role was to advise on implementation, not to set new rules or spending on its own. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: NASA and other federal agencies involved in space programs
who_it_affects.how: They would be the focus of the commission's advice on how to carry out the space exploration policy.
